verdict.rationale: Mastra is a self-hostable, Apache 2.0 framework that you can deploy anywhere, so stored data stays on your own infrastructure. Message-history memory is opt-in configuration, which gives indirect control over whether conversation data is retained at all. No evidence documents explicit retention policies, TTLs, or deletion APIs for threads, messages, snapshots or traces. Missing for 10: documented retention/TTL settings, thread/message deletion APIs, deletion of observability traces and workflow snapshots, independent corroboration.
